name: QC gate
summary: Every draft passes qc.py before it is sent: fix a BLOCK, answer an ASK with evidence, report a WARN.

nodes.title: Draft ready
nodes.sub: The exact words, in a file
nodes.body: Write the draft to a file so the receipt and the log match it word for word.

nodes.title: What did it say?
nodes.body:
- **BLOCK:** the draft can't go out.
- **ASK:** a judgment only you can make: answer it.
- **PASS or WARN:** it can go.

nodes.title: Fix and check again
nodes.body: Rewrite the draft and run the same check again.

nodes.title: Answer with evidence
nodes.body: Re-run with `--ok facts-read="README section Install, read this session"` (one per ASK).

nodes.title: Which filters apply
nodes.body:
- `python playbook/qc.py filters --platform X --action reply`.
- `python playbook/qc.py explain links-in-reply` prints the rule, its source and its examples.

nodes.title: Cleared to send
nodes.sub: The receipt is saved; audit.py add will accept these words
